title: U.S. debt hits $40 trillion faster than forecasters expected
description: The landmark number was reached in part because of lost revenue from invalidated tariffs.

title: Trump joins leaders of crypto companies in push for industry-backed bill
description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday called for Congress to pass legislation that could lend greater legitimacy to the fast-growing industry — which includes the Trump family business.

title: What it means that Democrats are winning special elections in Trump country
description: The latest victory came in a state House race near Butler, Pennsylvania, where Trump survived an attempt on his life in 2024 and won big.

title: Ties to data centers could cost Ohio Sen. Jon Husted his seat, memo warns
description: A GOP memo obtained by The Post urges the tech industry to take action to improve the image of the controversial facilities.

title: Trump says he expects to meet with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un later this year
description: In an impromptu White House meeting with reporters, the president touted his relationship with Kim and said North Korea has “57 very powerful nuclear weapons.”

title: What happens next to Alex Vindman’s multimillion-dollar war chest?
description: The Senate candidate raised more than $16 million before the Florida primary and probably will still have significant funds once outstanding balances are settled.

title: Prosecutors claim Comey posted  ‘86 47’ seashell photo to boost book sales
description: The Justice Department argues the former FBI director intentionally threatened the life of President Donald Trump in part to increase his book sales and says its prosecution of him is not vindictive.

title: Elon Musk posted, and she lost her job. Now, she seeks to clear her name.
description: A judge found that Mary Comans unlawfully lost her job at FEMA amid cuts by the U.S. DOGE Service.

title: Trump shows off his new helipad, brags about construction projects
description: For a brief period Wednesday, the president set aside more troubling issues to revel in his role as White House redeveloper.

title: Experts raise alarms over Census Bureau report Trump is touting on noncitizen voting
description: A Trump-aligned think tank has ties to a highly unusual Census Bureau report that the president is using to renew false claims of widespread voting by non-U.S. citizens in 2020, NPR has learned.

title: Three more Trump-endorsed candidates lose their primaries
description: So far, 10 candidates endorsed by President Donald Trump have lost their 2026 Republican primary races, nearly tying Trump's worst year in 2022.

title: Florida senate primary winner Angie Nixon relied on grassroots organizing
description: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Angie Nixon, a progressive democrat who won her U.S. Senate primary in Florida despite being massively outmatched in terms of spending.

title: Why a stunning democratic socialist win in Florida is different
description: Angie Nixon’s victory in the Senate primary was powered by voters who normally don’t gravitate to progressives in the state’s lowest-income and less-educated counties.

title: Darline Graham stumbles over national security question in debate
description: Graham, facing a GOP Senate primary runoff, admits she’s “not that informed” on foreign policy, the specialty of her late brother, Lindsey Graham.

title: How Trump’s dismissive comment could damage GOP chances in a key House race
description: The president has minimized poor conditions about the USS Abraham Lincoln. That could complicate a key House race.

title: 8 takeaways and surprises from Florida, Wyoming and Alaska primaries
description: Embattled Rep. Cory Mills (R-Florida) lost his reelection bid, another Trump gubernatorial pick fell, and another democratic socialist won a primary.

title: Elbridge who? How the name of a forgotten founder lives on in the word 'gerrymander'
description: Elbridge Gerry was an important early figure in the American Revolution, but his decision to approve a "gerrymandered" state legislative map inadvertently won him lasting infamy.

title: Rep. Cory Mills loses GOP primary after allegations of sexual misconduct
description: The Florida Republican lost to Ryan Elijah after facing allegations of sexual misconduct and domestic abuse, on top of campaign finance violations.

title: Trump revives unverified claims of noncitizen voting in 2020
description: President Donald Trump on Tuesday repeated his long-standing falsehoods about a rigged 2020 election.

title: Politics drove antisemitism probes against Ivy League schools, DOJ whistleblower says
description: A Trump administration task force on antisemitism pressured universities into punitive settlements despite turning up little to no evidence of systemic abuses, according to a former Justice Department attorney.

title: Former Fauci aide admits hiding emails to thwart pandemic inquiry
description: David M. Morens, who pleaded guilty to conspiracy to defraud the United States, said he was trying to protect his boss. Fauci was not accused of wrongdoing in the case.

title: Woman who planned to kill Treasury Secretary Bessent gets six years in prison
description: Riley English of Massachusetts turned herself in after arriving at the Capitol with miniature molotov cocktails just before Scott Bessent’s Senate confirmation.

title: Workers start latest repairs to Reflecting Pool liner, months after rehab began
description: The power washers, leaf blowers and brooms are back in use within the drained basin.

title: Trump administration moves to open untouched national forests to logging
description: The end of "roadless rule" protections would open millions of acres of pristine forests to commercial use. Supporters say it will lead to better managed forests.

title: Jill Stein, repeat Green Party candidate, faces assault charges in Missouri
description: Stein is facing misdemeanor charges of trespassing and assault over her role in a campus demonstration against the war in Gaza in 2024.

title: Ballroom opponents ask Supreme Court to keep Trump project on hold
description: The National Trust for Historic Preservation urged the high court to let a pause take effect. An appeals court ordered that the administration halt construction by Friday.

title: What to know about Natalie Harp, the Trump aide whom Ossoff put in the spotlight
description: The president’s executive assistant was among a small group of people who secretly switched planes with Trump over a potential Iranian threat, as noted by Sen. Jon Ossoff.

title: Key results from Florida primaries, so far
description: Voters in Florida are picking their party's candidates for governor, Senate and a number of U.S. House seats after redistricting.

title: Embattled Florida Republican Rep. Cory Mills loses his fight to keep his House seat
description: Mills is the latest lawmaker in a recent string of congressional members facing scandals and allegations of domestic abuse while trying to run for elected office.

title: The divide between Trump and Vance on Iran
description: Trump and Vance had differing answers about why the United States is waging war with Iran.

title: Backlash in Michigan complicates Democrats’ road to retaking the Senate
description: The party’s chances may depend on Abdul El-Sayed, who beat Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s preferred candidate and has criticized his support for Israel.

title: After bruising loss in Michigan, AIPAC turns to California for win
description: The organization’s super PAC poured nearly $2.5 million to boost Melissa Hernandez over Aisha Wahab in a California congressional race.

title: This crowded Republican primary in Florida has drawn a unique cast of candidates
description: The GOP primary in Florida's 19th District includes candidates who are new to the state, candidates who've run for Congress before and two candidates who have received pardons from President Trump.

title: Florida GOP race draws accusations of carpetbagging
description: "Carpetbagger" describes people who move somewhere to run for office. In Southwest Florida, six former congressional hopefuls from other states are taking their shot in this conservative stronghold.

title: Former federal prosecutor is suing DOJ for 'unlawful and retaliatory' firing
description: A federal prosecutor who was fired earlier this year is suing the DOJ, alleging she was unlawfully dismissed for political reasons tied to her work prosecuting a case against anti-abortion activists.

title: Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez being investigated over sexual misconduct allegations
description: The California Democrat has admitted to "personal mistakes" outside his marriage but also says his actions were consensual in nature and did not violate House ethics rules.
